dossier.purpose: Grype is an Apache-2.0 vulnerability scanner (CLI plus Go library) from Anchore for container images, filesystems/directories and SBOMs (README.md:7,24). It builds a package inventory in-process with the Syft library (or ingests an SBOM, PURL list or CPE list), matches packages against a locally cached SQLite vulnerability DB that it downloads from Anchore-hosted endpoints, applies ignore rules and OpenVEX/CSAF VEX, and writes table, JSON, CycloneDX, SARIF or Go-template reports. `--fail-on <severity>` makes the process exit 2 (cmd/grype/cli/cli.go:83-94; grype/pkg/provider.go:273-314; grype/vulnerability_matcher.go:99-142). It consumes SBOMs and matches vulnerabilities; it is not a standalone SBOM generator, workflow linter or attestation tool.

claims.claim: 'A vulnerability scanner for container images and filesystems.'
Scans container images, filesystems and SBOMs for known vulnerabilities
Supports major OS package ecosystems (Alpine, Debian, Ubuntu, RHEL, Oracle Linux, Amazon Linux, and more)
Supports language-specific packages (Ruby, Java, JavaScript, Python, .NET, Go, PHP, Rust, and more)
Supports Docker, OCI and Singularity image formats
Threat & risk prioritization with EPSS, KEV and risk scoring
OpenVEX support for filtering and augmenting scan results
Quickest install: curl -sSfL https://get.anchore.io/grype | sudo sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin
Installation docs list more ways to get Grype, including Homebrew, Docker, Chocolatey, MacPorts and more
Scan an SBOM 'for even faster vulnerability detection': `grype sbom:./sbom.json` or `cat ./sbom.json | grype`
Development is sponsored by Anchore and released under the Apache-2.0 License (license badge also shown)
CI badges for workflows named 'Static Analysis + Unit + Integration' and 'Validations'
Commercial support for Syft or Grype is available by contacting Anchore

install.method: Install script (curl | sh); detects linux/darwin/windows and amd64/arm64/ppc64le/s390x
Install script with cosign signature verification of the release checksums file (-v flag; needs cosign on PATH)

Homebrew (macOS and Linux archives are published as a cask to the anchore/homebrew-grype tap)
install.command: exact command is not in the repo; README.md:42 defers to the external install docs page (https://oss.anchore.com/docs/installation/grype/), which was not opened

platforms.linux_x86_64: yes - linux/amd64 static binary is built (.goreleaser.yaml:13-22, static link flags :25-32); hosted CI tests run on ubuntu-24.04 (.github/workflows/validations.yaml:16,33,113,258). arm64, ppc64le and s390x are also built.
platforms.wsl2: unknown - no WSL or WSL2 mention anywhere in the repo (searched). The Linux builds are CGO-free static binaries (.goreleaser.yaml:7-10,25-28), so a Linux-kernel environment is expected to run them, but upstream neither documents nor tests it.
platforms.macos_arm64: yes - darwin/arm64 binary is built and signed/notarized with quill (.goreleaser.yaml:34-48). Hosted macOS CI runs only the install.sh test suites and acceptance install of released builds, not the Go unit/integration/CLI suites (.github/workflows/validations.yaml:212-251; test/install/Makefile:35-36).
platforms.gpu: no - not applicable: CPU-only scanner; no GPU/CUDA/OpenCL references found in the repo (searched).

integrations.cli: Yes. `grype` binary (cmd/grype/main.go:22-34). Root scan command `grype [IMAGE|PATH|sbom:FILE|purl|cpe|...]` (cmd/grype/cli/commands/root.go:50-97) with -o/--output (table, json, cyclonedx, cyclonedx-json, sarif, template; internal/format/format.go:57-65), --file, --fail-on, --only-fixed/--only-notfixed, --vex, --exclude, --platform, --from, -s scope (cmd/grype/cli/options/grype.go:83-167), -c config and -v/-q (cmd/grype/cli/cli.go:37-41). Subcommands: db {check,delete,import,list,status,update,search,providers,diff} (cmd/grype/cli/commands/db.go:21-31), explain, completion [bash|zsh|fish], version, config (cmd/grype/cli/cli.go:105-111). Exit codes: 2 = severity threshold met, 100 = DB upgrade available (db check), 1 = other errors (cli.go:83-94).
integrations.mcp: none found (searched the repo for mcp / model context protocol; no server or tool-definition code).
integrations.sdk_or_api: Go library only, no HTTP/gRPC server code found. Module github.com/anchore/grype (go.mod:1) exposes grype.LoadVulnerabilityDB (grype/load_vulnerability_db.go:13), grype.VulnerabilityMatcher with FindMatches/FindMatchesContext (grype/vulnerability_matcher.go:39,90,99), pkg.Provide/ProvideFromReader (grype/pkg/provider.go:23,58) and SetLogger/SetBus (grype/lib.go:11-15). The older FindVulnerabilities API is marked deprecated 'will remove before v1.0.0' (grype/deprecated.go:14,34). The README does not document the library API. Machine-readable output: JSON, CycloneDX (JSON/XML), SARIF (internal/format/format.go:57-65); JSON schemas under schema/grype/ cover db-search, db-search-vuln, db-diff and DB blobs.
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: none found. The only hits are .gitignore entries that ignore local .claude and CLAUDE.md files (.gitignore:2-3,18-20); no skills, plugins, hooks or agent docs are shipped.

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry or analytics code found: zero OpenTelemetry/metrics imports in *.go (OTel modules appear only as indirect deps, go.mod:98-100,311-319). The README is silent on network use. Default outbound calls: (1) application update check, on by default: GET https://toolbox-data.anchore.io/grype/releases/latest/VERSION with header `User-Agent: grype <version>`, skipped for non-production builds (cmd/grype/cli/commands/update.go:14-27,52-57; cmd/grype/cli/options/grype.go:72; cmd/grype/cli/commands/root.go:161,348-370). (2) vulnerability DB: listing fetched from https://grype.anchore.io/databases/v6/latest.json and the DB archive downloaded when newer, auto-update on by default, same User-Agent (grype/db/v6/distribution/client.go:54-61,195-203,211-215; cmd/grype/cli/options/database.go:39; cmd/grype/cli/commands/root.go:181). DB cached under the XDG cache dir at grype/db, 5-day max DB age and checksum validation on by default; a DB older than 5 days makes the load fail unless updated, imported or validate-age is disabled (grype/db/v6/installation/curator.go:53-60,598-617; grype/load_vulnerability_db.go:38-41; cmd/grype/cli/commands/root.go:495-513). (3) Image sources contact registries or the local Docker/Podman daemon as selected. (4) Maven Central search (https://search.maven.org/solrsearch/select) only if external-sources.enable is set; default off (cmd/grype/cli/options/datasources.go:11,29-50). No Anchore account, API key or login is required; registry credentials are optional and cleared before the report is built (cmd/grype/cli/commands/root.go:251-252). Offline/limited use: GRYPE_CHECK_FOR_APP_UPDATE=false and GRYPE_DB_AUTO_UPDATE=false (test/cli/subprocess_test.go:36-38) plus `grype db import FILE | URL` (cmd/grype/cli/commands/db_import.go:19-24). DB integrity: sha256 digest from latest.json enforced by go-getter via a checksum query parameter and the on-disk digest is re-validated at load; no asymmetric signature verification of the DB or listing exists in code (grype/db/v6/distribution/client.go:139-143; grype/db/v6/distribution/latest.go:134-138; grype/db/v6/installation/curator.go:560-590). The DB downloader enables http, https, file, git, gcs, hg and s3 schemes (internal/file/getter.go:91-102).

entry_points.what: Binary main: builds the clio identification from ldflag vars (version, buildDate, gitCommit, gitDescription) and runs cli.Application (cmd/grype/main.go:15-34); imports the pure-Go sqlite driver.

Wires the clio/cobra app: global -c/-v/-q flags, UI selection, syft/stereoscope logger+bus hoisting, exit-code mapping (2 severity threshold, 100 DB upgrade available), subcommands db/completion/explain/version/config (cli.go:37-114).
Root scan command `grype [IMAGE]` and the runGrype pipeline: parallel app-update check, DB load and package gathering, then matching, VEX, output (root.go:50-280).
`grype db` subcommands: check, delete, import, list, status, update, search, providers, diff (db.go:15-34).
POSIX installer served at https://get.anchore.io/grype; flags -b DIR, -d, -v (cosign verify), optional TAG (install.sh:766-862, 773-801).

go-make task runner behind `make`: unit/lint/release tasks come from github.com/anchore/go-make; repo-specific build, integration, cli, quality, generate, schema-drift and install-test tasks are defined here (.make/main.go:23-53). Root Makefile only runs `go run -C .make .` (Makefile:1-18).

Library entry: LoadVulnerabilityDB (distribution client + curator + reader) (grype/load_vulnerability_db.go:13-49); matching entry is grype/vulnerability_matcher.go (VulnerabilityMatcher.FindMatches/FindMatchesContext, :39,90,99).

code.architecture: Single Go module. cmd/grype/: CLI (cobra via anchore/clio; commands/, options/ for config+flags, cli/ui and internal/ui Bubble Tea TUI fed by a partybus event bus). grype/pkg/: input providers; provide() tries PURL, CPE, SBOM file/stdin, Zarf, then Syft cataloging (provider.go:273-314); syft_provider.go:25 calls syft.CreateSBOM in-process for images/dirs, syft_sbom_provider.go decodes SBOMs via Syft format.Decode. grype/db/v6/: SQLite (GORM + glebarez/sqlite, CGO-free) vulnerability store, with distribution/ (latest.json client + go-getter download) and installation/ (curator: update, import, validate age/checksum); grype/db/v5 (earlier schema) is still in the tree; grype/db/v6/build, grype/db/processors and grype/db/provider hold DB build/transform code (no separate DB-builder main in this repo). grype/matcher/{apk,bitnami,dotnet,dpkg,golang,hex,java,javascript,msrc,pacman,portage,python,rpm,ruby,rust,stock}: per-ecosystem matchers. grype/vulnerability_matcher.go: orchestrates matchers, ignore rules, EOL tracking and VEX; grype/vex/{openvex,csaf}: VEX filtering/augmenting. grype/presenter/{table,json,cyclonedx,sarif,template,models}: output formats. internal/{dbtest,file,format,...}: DB test fixtures, go-getter wrapper, output selection. schema/: JSON schemas for db-search, db-search-vuln, db-diff and DB blobs. templates/: sample Go templates (html, junit, csv, markdown, table). test/{cli,integration,install,quality}: test suites.
code.packaging_and_release: GoReleaser v2 (.goreleaser.yaml:1): static CGO-free binaries (CGO_ENABLED=0; ldflags -s -w -extldflags '-static' plus version/commit/date, :7-32) for linux amd64/arm64/ppc64le/s390x, darwin amd64/arm64 (quill sign-and-notarize post-hook, :34-48) and windows amd64 (:50-58); tar.gz archives, zip for Windows (:60-72); rpm and deb via nfpms (:74-81); Homebrew cask pushed to anchore/homebrew-grype (:83-97); 12 Docker images (prod, nonroot, debug x amd64/arm64v8/ppc64le/s390x) pushed to Docker Hub and ghcr.io with multi-arch manifests :latest, :<tag>, :nonroot, :debug (:99-356; Dockerfile* use gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12 bases). Checksums: goreleaser file grype_<version>_checksums.txt, signed with cosign keyless (GitHub OIDC issuer) producing .sig and .pem for the checksum file only (.goreleaser.yaml:358-370; names per install.sh:383,400-416). install.sh always verifies the archive SHA-256 (install.sh:660) and, with -v, runs cosign verify-blob against identity https://github.com/anchore/grype/.github/workflows/release.yaml@refs/heads/main and issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com (install.sh:599-604). No SLSA/build-provenance attestation, no cosign attest, no signed container images and no per-artifact SBOM in goreleaser; Docker builds set --provenance=false (.goreleaser.yaml:109 and 11 others). Release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yaml): manual workflow_dispatch with version, phase, skip-checks inputs, serialized by a concurrency group (:5-28); jobs version-available -> check-gate (requires the 8 validations check names, :39-49) -> release (environment `release`, permissions contents/packages/id-token write, `make ci-release` with Docker Hub/GHCR logins, Apple notarization, tag and brew tokens; :55-111) -> anchore/sbom-action producing sbom.spdx.json over the checkout with continue-on-error (:113-116) -> release-install-script publishing install.sh to R2/S3 via anchore/workflows (:118-133). Process: RELEASE.md (`make release`, release admin approval :23-24, retraction steps :27-37, target cadence 1-2 weeks :9-11). go.mod pins syft v1.52.0 and a make task rejects non-release syft pins (.make/main.go:250-267; not shown wired to a workflow). Build is not bit-reproducible: mod_timestamp is set from the commit time (:23-24) but main.buildDate={{.Date}} (:31) and BUILD_DATE={{.Date}} (:111) embed build time.
code.tests_and_ci: Tests: Go testing + testify (go.mod:65), go-snaps snapshots (go.mod:32), go-cmp (go.mod:38), go-test/deep (go.mod:34); about 288 *_test.go files (cmd 25, grype 230, internal 18, test 15) plus 6 shell suites test/install/*_test.sh and a Python yardstick quality gate. Dirs: test/cli (runs the built snapshot binary), test/integration (Docker image fixtures), test/install (install.sh in Ubuntu/Alpine/Busybox containers), test/quality (yardstick F1/false-negative gate vs previous release with a pinned DB and the anchore/vulnerability-match-labels submodule, .gitmodules:1-4). `make unit` enforces a 47% coverage floor excluding **/test/** (.make/main.go:26-30). CI workflows in .github/workflows: validations.yaml (pull_request, push main, dispatch) runs jobs Static analysis=`make static-analysis`, Unit tests=`make unit`, Quality tests=`make quality`, Integration tests=`make integration` (also `db update` and `go run -race ./cmd/grype alpine:latest`, .make/main.go:87-94), Build snapshot artifacts=`make snapshot`, Acceptance tests (Linux)=`make install-test`, Acceptance tests (Mac)=`make install-test-ci-mac`, CLI tests (Linux)=`make cli`; validate-github-actions.yaml runs zizmor (zizmorcore/zizmor-action v0.6.3, advanced-security: true, inputs .github; config `rules: {}` in .github/zizmor.yml:1); codeql.yaml calls the reusable anchore/workflows CodeQL workflow on PR/push main/weekly cron with security-events: write (codeql.yaml:3-21); scorecards.yaml runs OSSF Scorecard weekly and on v* tags and uploads SARIF via github/codeql-action/upload-sarif (scorecards.yaml:6-10,46-49); release.yaml is manual (see packaging). Supply-chain facts: every workflow sets top-level permissions: {} with per-job scopes; all external `uses:` refs (13 distinct actions/reusable workflows) are pinned to 40-char SHAs with version comments (grep of .github); no pull_request_target, workflow_run, secrets: inherit or self-hosted runners; every checkout sets persist-credentials: false except the release job (release.yaml:72-75); test-fixture cache is write-enabled only on the upstream default branch (.github/actions/bootstrap/action.yaml:51-73). Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yaml): gomod for / and /.make, github-actions for / and /.github/actions/*, weekly Friday, 7-day cooldown, max 10 PRs; no docker or pip ecosystem. Static analysis config: golangci-lint (.golangci.yaml:5-28 incl. gosec, staticcheck, govet, errcheck, revive; gci+gofmt formatters), license allow-list .bouncer.yaml; what `make static-analysis` bundles is defined in the external go-make module, not in this checkout. No actionlint, shellcheck or hadolint anywhere (searched). In-repo SBOM generation: anchore/sbom-action in release only; Grype itself embeds Syft (go.mod:81). No workflow uploads Grype's own SARIF to code scanning; the code-scanning producers are CodeQL, Scorecard and zizmor.
code.dependencies: go.mod: 74 direct requires (including github.com/anchore/syft v1.52.0 at go.mod:81, go-containerregistry, stereoscope, clio, cobra, gorm + glebarez/sqlite, go-getter, cyclonedx-go, go-sarif, openvex/go-vex, csaf) and 257 `// indirect` requires (AWS/GCP SDKs, containerd, docker, otel); go 1.26.3; no replace or exclude directives; go.sum present. .make/go.mod: 1 direct (github.com/anchore/go-make v0.8.0) + 4 indirect; go 1.25.0. test/quality/requirements.txt: 3 pinned Python requirements (yardstick==v0.15.0, tabulate==0.9.0, dataclass-wizard==0.36.2). .binny.yaml declares only skopeo v1.24.0 (go-install) and inherits all other tool definitions (golangci-lint, goreleaser, cosign, quill, ...) from go-make's embedded config, which is not visible here (.binny.yaml:1-20). Five further go.mod files under testdata dirs are test fixtures, not product dependencies.
code.security_policy: SECURITY.md (repo root): security updates apply only to the most recent release (SECURITY.md:5); report privately by email to security@anchore.com with description, reproduction steps, affected versions and mitigations, and an urgency level; support is best effort (SECURITY.md:9-14); links to https://oss.anchore.com/docs/contributing/security/ (SECURITY.md:16). CONTRIBUTING.md:11 tells reporters not to open public issues. GitHub-side settings (private reporting, rulesets) are not visible in the checkout.

claim_checks.claim: Scans container images, filesystems and SBOMs; supports Docker, OCI and Singularity images (README.md:24,27)
claim_checks.evidence: Root command help lists docker, podman, registry, docker-archive, oci-archive, oci-dir, singularity, dir, file, sbom, purl, cpes and zarf sources (cmd/grype/cli/commands/root.go:56-77). Input dispatch tries PURL, CPE, SBOM, Zarf, then Syft cataloging (grype/pkg/provider.go:273-314); image/dir cataloging calls syft.CreateSBOM in-process (grype/pkg/syft_provider.go:25).

claim_checks.claim: Threat & risk prioritization with EPSS, KEV and risk scoring (README.md:28)
claim_checks.evidence: JSON model carries risk (grype/presenter/models/vulnerability.go:15,64) and knownExploited/epss (grype/presenter/models/vulnerability_metadata.go:17-18); sort strategies epss and risk (grype/presenter/models/sort.go:15-16); DB build processors for EPSS and KEV exist (grype/db/processors/epss_processor.go, kev_processor.go).

claim_checks.claim: OpenVEX support for filtering and augmenting scan results (README.md:29)
claim_checks.evidence: grype/vex/processor.go:24-32,97-108 applies FilterMatches (moves not_affected/fixed matches to ignored) and AugmentMatches (adds matches for products the VEX lists as affected); OpenVEX implementation in grype/vex/openvex/implementation.go; CSAF VEX is also supported (grype/vex/csaf/); --vex flag at cmd/grype/cli/options/grype.go:163-166.

claim_checks.claim: Quickest install is the curl | sudo sh one-liner (README.md:36-39)
claim_checks.evidence: install.sh:9 sets https://get.anchore.io/grype as base URL; the script re-fetches the tag-specific install.sh and pipes it into sh (install.sh:837-846), always verifies the archive SHA-256 against the release checksums file (install.sh:631-660), and verifies the cosign signature of that checksums file only when -v is passed and cosign is installed (install.sh:642-654,757-763,794). The README one-liner omits -v, so it checks integrity but not signature authenticity.

claim_checks.claim: README badge for a workflow named 'Static Analysis + Unit + Integration' (README.md:10)
claim_checks.evidence: No such workflow exists: .github/workflows contains Validations (validations.yaml:1), Release, CodeQL, Scorecards and Validate GitHub Actions. Static analysis, unit and integration tests now run as jobs of validations.yaml:13-133. The first badge points at a stale workflow name; code wins.

claim_checks.claim: More ways to install include Homebrew, Docker, Chocolatey, MacPorts (README.md:42)
claim_checks.evidence: Homebrew cask (.goreleaser.yaml:83-97) and Docker Hub/GHCR images (.goreleaser.yaml:99-356; RELEASE.md:6-7) are produced by this repo's release. No Chocolatey or MacPorts configuration found in the repo (searched for choco/port install), so those are not checkable here; exact commands live on an external docs page that was not opened.

claim_checks.claim: Scanning an SBOM is 'even faster'; `cat ./sbom.json | grype` works (README.md:56-64)
claim_checks.evidence: Piped stdin and the sbom: prefix are implemented (grype/pkg/syft_sbom_provider.go:101-108,118-120; cmd/grype/cli/commands/root.go:515-539), decoded with Syft format.Decode (syft_sbom_provider.go:86), and SBOM inputs skip cataloging because provide() tries the SBOM provider before syftProvider (grype/pkg/provider.go:286-313). The 'faster' claim is not measured anywhere in the repo (no published benchmark results).

claim_checks.claim: (Workflow comment, not README) zizmor findings are enforced by a pass/fail repo ruleset (.github/workflows/validate-github-actions.yaml:30)
claim_checks.evidence: GitHub repository rulesets are not in the checkout. In-repo facts: zizmor-action pinned by SHA (validate-github-actions.yaml:28), advanced-security: true and inputs: .github (:30-32), config `rules: {}` (.github/zizmor.yml:1), job permissions contents: read and security-events: write (:19-21).

claim_checks.claim: (Goreleaser comment, not README) mod_timestamp is set 'to ensure a reproducible build' (.goreleaser.yaml:23-24)
claim_checks.evidence: Binary mtime is set from the commit timestamp, with CGO_ENABLED=0 and static linking (.goreleaser.yaml:7-10,24-28). But ldflags also inject main.buildDate={{.Date}} (:31) and Docker builds pass BUILD_DATE={{.Date}} (:111); no -trimpath is configured; no CI job rebuilds and compares artifacts (only this comment matches 'reproducib' in non-test config).

claim_checks.claim: (CLI help text, not README) --fail-on sets the return code to 2 (cmd/grype/cli/options/grype.go:118-121) vs config text saying the return code 'will be 1' (grype.go:199)
claim_checks.evidence: The code maps ErrAboveSeverityThreshold to exit code 2 (cmd/grype/cli/cli.go:84-88) and DB-upgrade-available to 100 (cli.go:89-92); the config-file description at cmd/grype/cli/options/grype.go:199 still says 1. Code behavior (2) wins; help text inside the tool is inconsistent, which matters when gating CI on exit codes.

benchmarks.what: Match-quality gate thresholds vs the previous release (these are pass/fail thresholds, not measured results); no scan-speed or accuracy results are published in the repo
benchmarks.source: test/quality/.yardstick.yaml:88-94 (repeated for the 2022-2025 result sets, e.g. :127-134); criteria prose in test/quality/README.md:34-61

benchmarks.what: Unit-test coverage floor enforced by `make unit` (threshold, not a measurement)
Vulnerability DB download sizes as stated in config help text (stale sample)
benchmarks.metric: DB archive size / latest.json listing size

risks: Signing/attestation gap: only the release checksums file is cosign-signed (.goreleaser.yaml:358-370); no build-provenance/SLSA attestation, no cosign attest, no signed container images or SBOM attestations in goreleaser or .github (searched); Docker builds pass --provenance=false (.goreleaser.yaml:109 and 11 others); the only SBOM step is anchore/sbom-action over the checkout with continue-on-error (.github/workflows/release.yaml:113-116); the README one-liner verifies only a SHA-256 from the same release unless -v and cosign are used (install.sh:660,794).

Not bit-for-bit reproducible: mod_timestamp is normalized to commit time (.goreleaser.yaml:23-24) but ldflags embed main.buildDate={{.Date}} (:31) and Docker builds pass BUILD_DATE={{.Date}} (:111); no -trimpath; no rebuild-and-compare job exists in .github/workflows.

Pinning gaps outside Go modules and actions: Dockerfile base images use mutable tags gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:latest|nonroot|debug-nonroot (Dockerfile:1; Dockerfile.nonroot:1; Dockerfile.debug:1) while Dependabot watches only gomod and github-actions (.github/dependabot.yaml:7,25); install-test images download the latest cosign (test/install/environments/Dockerfile-ubuntu-20.04:3-5); apt packages unpinned (.github/actions/bootstrap/action.yaml:42-49); floating runner labels ubuntu-latest and macos-latest (.github/workflows/scorecards.yaml:17; validate-github-actions.yaml:18; validations.yaml:216). All action refs themselves are SHA-pinned.

Key CI/release logic lives outside this checkout: `make static-analysis`, `make ci-release` and `make snapshot` come from anchore/go-make v0.8.0 (.make/main.go:23-53; .make/go.mod:5); CodeQL, check-gate, version check and install-script publishing are reusable workflows in anchore/workflows@7212994d (v0.8.0) (release.yaml:35,44,123; codeql.yaml:16); tool versions come from go-make's embedded .binny.yaml (.binny.yaml:3-5). Release workflow: skip-checks input bypasses the check-gate (release.yaml:24-28,40), checkout persists credentials (release.yaml:72-75), and the job holds contents/packages/id-token write plus Docker Hub, Apple, tag, brew and R2/S3 secrets (release.yaml:67-70,96-111,126-133); gated by environment `release` approval (release.yaml:65; RELEASE.md:23-24).

No workflow-syntax linter: no actionlint or shellcheck anywhere (searched), so workflow expressions, action inputs/outputs and run: scripts are not linted; zizmor runs with default rules (`rules: {}`, .github/zizmor.yml:1) and its pass/fail enforcement is a repo ruleset not visible in the checkout (validate-github-actions.yaml:30).

Version/maintenance: pre-1.0 (v0.119.0); deprecated APIs and output formats are slated for removal before v1.0 (grype/deprecated.go:14,34; internal/format/format.go:17,67); .chronicle.yaml sets enforce-v0 so breaking-change labels do not bump the major version (.chronicle.yaml:1); security fixes apply only to the latest release (SECURITY.md:5); DB distribution has deprecated and end-of-life states that stop DB updates for old Grype versions (grype/db/v6/distribution/status.go:11-15; client.go:113-117).

Runtime network and integrity: app-update check and DB auto-update are on by default and call Anchore-hosted endpoints (cmd/grype/cli/options/grype.go:72; options/database.go:39; commands/update.go:18-19; distribution/client.go:56); with the default 5-day max DB age an offline or stale DB makes scans fail unless updated, imported or age validation is disabled (installation/curator.go:56-58,598-614; grype/load_vulnerability_db.go:38-41); DB authenticity rests on HTTPS plus a digest from latest.json with no signature verification (distribution/client.go:139-143; latest.go:134-138); the downloader also enables file/git/gcs/hg/s3 schemes (internal/file/getter.go:91-102).

Test and platform coverage: hosted unit, integration and CLI tests run on Linux only; macOS CI runs just the install.sh suites (validations.yaml:212-251; test/install/Makefile:35-36); WSL2 is undocumented and untested; the quality gate relies on a custom runner label ubuntu-22.04-4core-16gb (validations.yaml:52), a pinned DB URL and a GHCR SBOM store (test/quality/test-db:1; test/quality/Makefile:1-2) and `make quality` runs 3 of the 5 defined result sets (2023 and 2025 defined at .yardstick.yaml:171,265 but not invoked at Makefile:30,37-39); coverage floor is only 47% (.make/main.go:27); dependency surface is 74 direct and 257 indirect modules (go.mod).

checks.statement: Install script (curl | sh); detects linux/darwin/windows and amd64/arm64/ppc64le/s390x. Command: curl -sSfL https://get.anchore.io/grype | sudo sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin
checks.note: README.md:38 has the exact one-liner. install.sh:126-157 is the GOOS/GOARCH allow-list from uname_os_check/uname_arch_check: darwin:126, linux:129, windows:136, amd64:146, arm64:147, ppc64le:152, s390x:157. The detection itself is uname_os (install.sh:444-457, which maps cygwin/mingw/msys to windows) and uname_arch (:463-481, x86_64->amd64, aarch64->arm64). The allow-list also accepts values with no release asset (freebsd, 386, armv7...). The asset is then looked up by name in the checksums file (:423-438), so only goreleaser's targets resolve: linux amd64/arm64/ppc64le/s390x, darwin amd64/arm64, windows amd64 (.goreleaser.yaml:16-22,37-41,53-56).

LICENSE:1-3 is the unmodified Apache License, Version 2.0 text (appendix boilerplate left unfilled). Consistent with README.md:15 (badge) and :77, and .goreleaser.yaml:75,93 (package/cask metadata). There is no other license file at the repo root; the only other LICENSE is a test fixture under test/integration/testdata.
